startPopulation.label: People at turn 1 (half of them women)

foragePerPerson.label: Food foraged per person per turn, before crowding

landCapacity.label: How many foragers the land feeds before returns thin out

weatherSwing.label: How far a turn's foraging can swing up or down (0.15 = 15%)

eatPerPerson.label: Food eaten per person per turn

spoilage.label: Share of stored food lost per turn

baseCapacity.label: People the camp holds without built shelter

gestation.label: Turns a pregnancy lasts (a turn is a season)

restTurns.label: Extra turns a mother rests after giving birth before she can conceive again (0 = the next turn)

conceiveChance.label: Chance each rested woman conceives in a turn, when well fed and not crowded

mateRatio.label: Men needed per woman for full fertility (fewer men, fewer pregnancies)

miscarriageRate.label: Chance a pregnancy is lost each turn (higher when people are hungry)

birthDeathRate.label: Chance a mother dies giving birth

infantTurns.label: Turns a baby counts as an infant (more fragile)

infantDeathRate.label: Extra chance an infant dies each turn

birthFoodTurns.label: Turns of stored food needed for full fertility (less food, fewer pregnancies)

crowdBirthDrop.label: How sharply pregnancies fall off when the camp is over capacity

deathRate.label: Chance an adult dies each turn (illness, accidents, age)

childDeathRate.label: Chance a child dies each turn

childVulnerability.label: How much harder famine hits children than adults

childEat.label: Food a child eats per turn (children don't forage or learn yet)

matureTurns.label: Turns until a child grows up and starts working

hungerTurns.label: Below this many turns of stored food, people get anxious

hungerUnrest.label: Stability lost per turn at zero stored food

crowdUnrest.label: Stability lost per turn for each 10% the camp is over capacity

contentTurns.label: Turns of stored food that make people feel secure

contentment.label: Stability gained per turn when secure and not crowded

leaveRate.label: Share of adults who leave per turn at zero stability

minStay.label: Adults who always stay, however unhappy

leaveFoodShare.label: Share of stored food that leavers take (1 = their fair share)

leaveKnowledge.label: Knowledge leavers take, as a multiple of their share of the people

leaveRelief.label: Stability regained when the unhappy ones are gone

starvationRate.label: Share of the unfed who die in a famine turn

famineUnrest.label: Stability lost in a famine turn

laborEnergy.label: Energy (labor and firewood) gathered per person per turn

woodCapacity.label: How many people the nearby trees keep supplied before wood gets harder to find

knowledgePerPerson.label: Knowledge gained per person per turn

knowledgeDecay.label: Share of knowledge forgotten per turn

stabilityRest.label: Stability the group drifts toward when nothing pushes it

stabilityPull.label: How fast stability drifts back toward rest

unrestThreshold.label: Below this stability, people start leaving (the lower it is, the more go)

armsRaceInterval.label: Turns between border decisions with a rival

firstArmsTurn.label: Turn of the first border decision

armsCost.label: Food spent each time you build arms

armsUpkeep.label: Food per turn to keep each level of arms

raidLoss.label: Share of stored food lost when you disarm and they build

tribute.label: Food gained when you build and they disarm

securityToStability.label: Stability change per security point above or below 2

trustGain.label: Trust a rival gains when you disarm

trustLoss.label: Trust a rival loses when you build

treatyBreakPenalty.label: Extra trust lost for building after pledging to disarm

startWomen.label: Women at turn 1; all of them start out pregnant
